estimand: Episode-level E-minus-control loss differences, equally averaged within each duration/fold and equally across the three durations and three folds; sites separate.
limits: The control analysis was designed after the original results were inspected.
Both controls use constant displacement and gamma=0; comparison against flexible E is not an isolated deadzone or smoothness ablation.
The two scalar policies have separately validation-selected settings; differences do not isolate a numerical parameter while holding all others fixed.
Original E trajectories are not reconstructed; their archived losses are preserved.
Intervals condition on realized masks and fitted/selected policies; H1 fails the main seven-day support rule.
No meter semantics, external generalization, or independent confirmation is established.
multiplicity: 18 exploratory site/control/block-length summaries; pointwise intervals and unadjusted exploratory p-values; no familywise or FDR control claim.
